asked.item: full 5,000 Creator credits right away after upgrading mid-cycle
prorated credits for the rest of the month after upgrading mid-cycle

verdict.reason: The sentences do not say how credits are granted when a monthly plan is upgraded mid-cycle; S39 covers proration of the charge when switching monthly to yearly, not credit allowance on a plan upgrade, and S59 only says the paid allowance starts when the paid subscription starts.
